title: vLLM Serving Overview
description: Bootstrap dashboard. Run scripts/prepare_dashboard.py against an actual vLLM metrics snapshot before provisioning the full serving overview.

options.content: Generate this dashboard with scripts/prepare_dashboard.py using the running vLLM 0.26.0 /metrics snapshot. The generator includes running/waiting requests, KV cache, latency histograms, token rates, request activity and queue/prefill/decode only when their real TYPE descriptors are present. Client benchmark JSON is the authoritative SLO measurement.
